system.description:
With a guttural, chakra infused exhalation, you release the fury of the dragon coiled within. Chakra surges from within, shattering the air in a concussive, bestial roar, shattering the wills of those who would dare oppose you. Hostile creatures in range must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Success: The affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effect.

Failure: Affected creatures gain 1 rank of Demoralized and Shaken.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they gain 2 ranks of each.

Dragons Rage. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, allied creatures in range gain a +1 bonus to the next dice roll they make before the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the size of the shockwave by 5 feet. If this jutsu is Cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Demoralized, Shaken and the bonus allied creatures gain by +1. If this jutsu is Cast at S-Rank, increase the ranks of Demoralized, Shaken and the bonus allied creatures gain by +1.
